userInput: Current solution works but feels aesthetically inconsistent. Considering moving the upload button from Selected Mixins panel to the 'Manage Uploaded Mixins' popup instead. Only locally uploaded files would show in the mixins popup, upload would happen exclusively through the manage panel. What are the pros/cons of this approach vs alternatives?

alternatives.name: Keep Current Solution: Upload Button in Selected Mixins Panel
alternatives.description: Leave upload button in the Selected Mixins panel header as currently implemented. Button is always visible and provides quick access to upload functionality.
pros: Always visible - maximum discoverability
One-click access from main UI
Consistent with other toolbar actions
No need to open popup to upload
Already implemented and working
cons: Feels out of place aesthetically in the mixins panel
Takes up space in panel header
Mixes upload action with selection display
Inconsistent with upload workflow (manage panel is the dedicated upload area)
User's feedback: feels 'ugly'

alternatives.name: User's Suggestion: Move Upload Button to Manage Uploaded Mixins Popup
alternatives.description: Remove upload button from Selected Mixins panel. Add upload button only to the 'Manage Uploaded Mixins' popup. All upload operations happen in this dedicated popup. Uploaded files shown in both popup and dropdown.
pros: Cleaner aesthetics - upload action isolated to dedicated panel
Clear workflow: upload and manage in one place
Consistent UX: all upload operations in one location
Reduces visual clutter in main Selected Mixins panel
Better organization: selection separate from management
Upload button has proper context (surrounded by other upload-related features)
Aligns with user expectation of where upload should be
cons: Less discoverable - requires clicking 'Manage Uploaded Mixins' button first
Extra click required to upload files
Users might not find upload feature if they don't explore manage panel
Slight delay: need to open popup to upload (vs one-click from panel)
Not immediately visible to new users

alternatives.name: Upload Button in Uploads Group Header (Dropdown Only)
alternatives.description: Remove upload button from Selected Mixins panel. Add upload button ONLY to the Uploads group header in the grouped dropdown (already partially implemented in Phase 3). Upload is only accessible from dropdown.
pros: Contextual: button appears next to Uploads group where it belongs
Clean Selected Mixins panel header
Consistent with grouped dropdown architecture
Uploads group shows available uploads, header has upload button
Aligns with YAML format philosophy (sections contain related items)
cons: Requires opening dropdown to access upload
Even less discoverable than manage panel approach
No upload button in manage panel (split functionality)
Inconsistent if some uploads show in manage popup but upload button elsewhere
Users need to remember two different upload workflows
May confuse users: why upload in dropdown instead of manage panel?

alternatives.name: Dedicated Upload Button in Main Toolbar
alternatives.description: Add a dedicated upload button to the main toolbar (like the search, zoom buttons). Always visible in the main UI but not mixed with Selected Mixins panel. Clicking opens file dialog or manages uploads.
pros: Prominent, always visible location
Consistent with other toolbar actions (zoom, search, etc.)
One-click access from anywhere
Clear visual hierarchy - upload is a primary action
Professional look - clean integration with toolbar
No visual clutter in side panels
cons: Toolbar is already crowded with many buttons
Takes up valuable toolbar real estate
Requires scrolling on small viewports
Deviates from current grouped dropdown pattern
Upload button might be missed among other controls
Adds visual complexity to main interface

alternatives.name: Smart Hybrid: Upload in Manage Panel + Upload Icon in Dropdown Group Header
alternatives.description: Keep upload button in 'Manage Uploaded Mixins' popup as main upload location (cleaner). Also add upload icon in Uploads group header in dropdown for quick access. Both paths lead to same upload dialog.
pros: Best of both worlds: dedicated location + quick access
Cleaner aesthetics than current solution
High discoverability: appears in two places
Serves different user workflows: quick upload vs managed upload
Users can choose their preference
Consistent with both manage panel and dropdown paradigms
No selected-mixins panel clutter
cons: Two upload entry points might confuse some users
Slight code duplication (two button handlers)
More buttons in UI overall
Dropdown group header becomes busier
Might be overkill if one location is sufficient

alternatives.name: Upload in Manage Panel with Visual Indicator on Dropdown
alternatives.description: Move upload button exclusively to Manage Uploaded Mixins popup (cleaner). Add a small badge or visual indicator to the Uploads group in dropdown showing upload count. Badge/indicator hints that this is the uploads section, manage button takes you to full management.
pros: Clean aesthetics - upload only in dedicated manage panel
Visual indicator hints at uploads without cluttering dropdown
Consistent with current UI patterns (badges, indicators)
Clear UX flow: manage button opens manage panel with upload
Reduces button proliferation in UI
Professional appearance
cons: Still less discoverable than having upload button visible
Indicator alone doesn't clearly show upload is possible
Users still need to find manage button to upload
Requires adding badge/indicator logic (slight complexity)
Doesn't solve the 'upload not immediately discoverable' issue completely

recommendation.approach: Alternative 2: Move Upload Button Exclusively to Manage Uploaded Mixins Popup
recommendation.rationale:
This is the best approach for your use case based on the user feedback about aesthetics. Here's why:

**UX Benefits:**
1. **Cleaner Aesthetics** - Removes the 'ugly' upload button from the Selected Mixins panel header, keeping that panel clean and focused on selection display
2. **Logical Workflow** - Users expect upload/management operations to be in the "Manage Uploaded Mixins" panel, not scattered across the UI
3. **Consistent Mental Model** - All upload-related operations (upload, delete, view details) happen in one dedicated location
4. **Professional Appearance** - Selected Mixins panel becomes cleaner, focusing on its primary purpose (showing selected items)

**Implementation Details:**
1. Remove the upload button from Selected Mixins panel header (revert part of Phase 3)
2. Add upload button to the Manage Uploaded Mixins popup (already exists, just add button)
3. Keep Uploads group in dropdown for discoverability (users see they have uploads)
4. All upload operations: user clicks "Manage Uploaded Mixins" → popup opens → uploads from there

**Discoverability Trade-off:**
The slight reduction in discoverability (requires one extra click vs immediate access) is acceptable because:
- Users will naturally find "Manage Uploaded Mixins" button when they want to upload
- The tooltip and icon make the purpose clear
- The Uploads group appearing in dropdown reminds users uploads exist
- This is how most file management systems work (dedicated management area)

**Recommended Implementation:**
1. Remove `btn-selected-collector-upload` from Selected Mixins panel in index.html
2. Add upload button to the Manage Uploaded Mixins popup header
3. Wire handler to same `triggerToolbarComboUpload()` function
4. Keep Uploads group in dropdown (no changes needed)
5. Result: Clean UI, logical workflow, professional appearance

**Complexity:** Low - mostly reverting Phase 3 panel changes and adding button to existing popup (which already has similar buttons)

notes: Current implementation already shows Uploads group in dropdown (from Phase 2 fix), so users can see they have uploads available
The Manage Uploaded Mixins popup already has delete/management UI, making it the natural place for upload too
This approach follows the principle of 'one place for related operations' (upload, delete, rename all in manage panel)
User feedback was that current solution 'works but is ugly' - this directly addresses the aesthetics concern
Alternative 5 (hybrid with upload in both places) could be considered if upload discovery becomes an issue after this change
The solution maintains the fix from Phase 2 (Uploads group visible) while improving UX of upload access
